findings.title: Bind the preparation tasks and blank adjudication form to the captured gold and intake declarations
findings.problem: The response schema admits preparation as a record of unknown values. The client verifies the preparation content hash but only counts preparation.adjudication.item_tasks. It compares the report blank_submission to the preparation blank_submission, without comparing either to the original gold packet, adjudicator handle or empty decisions. That is returned-copy consistency rather than original-input binding.
concrete_static_counterexample_recipe_UN: Start from the existing native positive complete response for the three-item gold packet, leaving raw input bindings, all submitted packets, full-N/missing counters and final report.adjudication.item_tasks unchanged.
Change preparation.adjudication.item_tasks[0].id to a different ordinary string while leaving its source_ids/required_review_roles/status and verified_submissions:null unchanged.
Recompute preparation.content_hash and then the outer report.content_hash with the protected canonical hash function; update the sole JSON text to equal the complete structuredContent.

Every inspected predicate still passes by source tracing: the output schema accepts preparation records, original byte/hash bindings remain exact, NULL fields are unchanged, preparation task length stays N, and lines593-601 inspect only the final report tasks. The modified preparation task is included in the persisted full report.

A second variant changes both returned blank_submission objects together, for example packet_sha256 or adjudicator, and rehashes preparation plus report. No inspected predicate binds either returned blank form to the captured gold/declared adjudicator.

evidence.fact: Output-schema and exact text/structured comparison; preparation schema is permissive.
Preparation self hash is checked, which an altered report can recompute.
Only preparation task count and blank-form equality to another returned copy.
The row/source/missing-field loop validates final report tasks only.
Protected producer constructs declared_handle, blank schema/adjudicator/packet_sha256/empty decisions and gold-derived item IDs/source IDs/roles/status/nulls.
Complete captured-input and adjudication-task binding is an explicit acceptance requirement.

findings.bounded_correction: Independently bind preparation declared_handle, the blank form schema/adjudicator/packet_sha256/empty decisions and each preparation task ID, source IDs, fixed review roles/status and NULL verified_submissions to the captured inputs. Compare both report and preparation blank forms to the expected original-bound form. Keep one authoritative SDK audit and the entire full report; do not run a second kernel or authenticate declared source pins.
findings.meaningful_native_regression: Extend the existing rehashed-tamper native case with altered preparation task ID/source IDs and paired altered blank forms after both hashes are recomputed. Include an unchanged complete positive response. No extra actual SDK/command/pack site or new test name is required.

findings.title: Own EAGAIN while completing one bounded diagnostic frame before admission
findings.problem: Both new client and old expert-files diagnosticNow functions loop captured native fs.writeSync to stdout without handling nonblocking EAGAIN. A partial frame can be emitted and then the before hook fails before any affected case body runs. Immediate RAW custody is not complete at that point.
findings.independent_failed_scope: All40 new names and all40 old expert-files names are hookFailed/EAGAIN in the retained original. Fund387 has306PASS81FAIL. No new command or SDK case body ran.
findings.bounded_correction: Resume only the untransferred suffix of the same frame on EAGAIN under one fixed finite absolute monotonic diagnostic clock, yielding without spawning work. Await complete RAW before gzip/TAR/member/guide admission; preserve RAW_MODES then distinct ADMITTED ordering, exact bytes, current caps/guards/cleanup and source/header semantics. Retain partial output on terminal refusal rather than resending a second frame.
findings.meaningful_native_regression: Use the same captured-writer injection to prove partial progress followed by EAGAIN and later progress yields exact frame bytes once, a permanent-EAGAIN deadline refuses, zero/invalid progress refuses, overcap writes nothing, and a later admission/hook refusal retains a complete RAW frame. Maintain positive control and no duplicate pack/command.
